reply.text:
Starting is almost always a good idea at any age, and lifting is one of the best things you can do to stay strong and independent. Whether it's safe for you in particular is a question for your doctor, especially if you have a heart condition, high blood pressure, or take any medications. Get their clearance first, and tell them what you plan to do.

Once you have it, I can help from the training side. Beginners at any age usually start light, with simple machine or bodyweight movements, a couple of days a week and a day of rest between sessions. The goal early on is learning the movements well, not chasing weight.

If you'd like, tell me how many days a week you can train, how long you want each session to be, and whether you'll be in a gym or at home, and I'll set up a program for you to look over.
